Arthur and the Revenge of Maltazard.name: Arthur and the Revenge of Maltazard
Arthur and the Revenge of Maltazard.summary: Arthur and the revenge of Maltazard is a Party Game directly inspired by the second movie of the trilogy Arthur and the Minimoys.

Crazy Machines.name: Crazy Machines
Crazy Machines.summary: Turn the crank, rotate the gears, push the levers, Use the catapult, explode it, or fly it...From grilling sausages with a pulley, gears, rubberbands and a candle to firing a cannon with a basketball, these wacky brain-teasers will light up your imagination with creative and addictive fun.

Diner Dash - Sizzle & Serve.name: Diner Dash: Sizzle & Serve
Diner Dash - Sizzle & Serve.summary: Welcome to Diner Dash, the action-puzzle that brings out the entrepreneur in all of us! Poor Flo! Sick and tired of pushing paper in the dreary, bleary-eyed world of finance, she ditched her desk job and now she's rolling up her sleeves and setting out to build her very own empire of high-class, five-star restaurants. It won't be easy, though! Flo's on her own now, and heading for the top! To get there she'll have to start on the ground floor—and she needs your help to survive and thrive. Diner Dash blends the best in fast paced-action puzzles with a build-your-restaurant-empire theme that encourages players to serve their way from a two-table diner to the top of the restaurant ladder – starting with a run-of-the-mill greasy spoon and ending in a dream restaurant.

Drake & Josh - Talent Showdown.name: Drake & Josh: Talent Showdown
Drake & Josh - Talent Showdown.summary:
Drake & Josh Face Their Biggest Talent Showdown Ever!

"Teen American Talent," the hottest talent competition, has everyone abuzz at Belleview High. Drake is desperate to win the "best musical act" while Josh hones his magic tricks. Help them perfect their talent and avoid sabotages from their competitors.

Features:

•Perform dazzling magic tricks
•Battle your way through bullies!
•Strum guitar strings to make rockin' music!

Wario - Master of Disguise.name: Wario: Master of Disguise
Wario - Master of Disguise.summary:
The world's most low-down and ornery garlic-lover never lets a get-rich quick scheme pass him by. Wario: Master of Disguise opens with our money-mad hero taking a break from being a shady software impresario to watch a TV show about a master thief. Working himself up into a lather of jealousy, Wario leaps through the screen and embarks on his own glamorous globe-trotting career as a thief.
With the helpful advice of a mustachioed magic wand named Goodstyle, you'll soon learn how to use your DS stylus to draw specific designs on Wario to give him new costumes. Break into exotic locations, from a luxury liner & watery ruins to an Egyptian pyramid, all in the hopes of grabbing as much treasure and loot as Wario can carry.
